pending_part_2.voiceover_script: Microscopic analysis revealed the toxic rain falling from the sky was actually teeming with living human white blood cells. In Part 1, we explored the toxic blob storm that sickened Oakville... but when lab technicians analyzed the mystery substance, the horror magnified. Laboratory tests confirmed the gelatinous goo contained two distinct species of living bacteria, including a human pathogen capable of causing severe respiratory distress. Even stranger, researchers discovered complex biological structures identical to human immune cells suspended inside the matrix. Theories erupted—was it pulverized marine life launched by offshore naval bombing runs, or a covert military biological test? Before independent labs could complete DNA sequencing, government officials inexplicably destroyed every remaining sample. The original laboratory records vanished, leaving Oakville’s deadly rain mystery unresolved forever.
